title: VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.00972v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. translated_title: VeriHarness：面向长程任务的规模化智能体验证
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型智能体承担日益复杂的长程任务，验证其输出也变得愈发具有挑战性。我们研究了如何在固定基础模型、且测试时无法获得参考答案或评分标准的情况下增强验证能力。重复采样会产生多个可能包含互补性正确论断的 rollout，但我们需要一种可靠的验证机制来确定哪些论断值得信任。我们首先发现，分歧往往能暴露出正确的替代方案，而共识反而可能掩盖错误。这些观察促成了 VeriHarness 的提出：它通过为生成器所使用的底层大模型提供工作空间、证据工具以及可复用的验证技能，将其转变为一个智能体化的验证器。分歧裁决器会对照环境证据核查相互竞争的论断，而共识挑战者则会测试被共同认可的论断并搜寻被遗漏的需求。它们的发现用于指导最终答案的选择与修订。
tldr: VeriHarness 通过为底层大模型提供工作空间、证据工具和可复用验证技能，并配合分歧裁决器与共识挑战者两个机制，在无参考答案和评分标准的条件下显著提升了智能体长程任务输出的验证能力。
en_tdlr: VeriHarness turns an LLM into an agentic verifier—equipped with a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills, combined with a disagreement resolver and a consensus challenger—to reliably verify long-horizon agent task outputs without reference answers or grading rubrics.
